name: Ultimate Metro
summary: Tram-based metro termini and a through station with a pedestrian underpass.
description: Ultimate Metro 0.9.2 gives the through station six pedestrian street access points: front, middle and back of both platforms. Central entries reuse the native outer walkway around the stair opening; passengers can reach both platforms via the underpass from every entrance. The catchment centre moves to the station midpoint with the same 160m radius. Nearby roads are connected by the native short-footpath system. Track layout, native tram behavior, speed correction, terminus stations and underpass geometry are retained. New entrance connections require in-game validation on a newly built station; existing saved construction geometry is not rebuilt automatically. Configurable station family remains future work. Do not remove the mod while its stations remain.
